title: [v3-rc3] Bolus Dialog does not close on cancel
symptom: When cancelling a bolus in progress with an Omnipod Eros, the dialog shows a message and cannot be closed, although the pump cancels correctly. Workaround is to minimize and reopen the app.
cause: The timestamps do not match; the running timestamp and close request timestamp differ, preventing the dialog from closing.
evidence_quote: It seems that the timestamps do not match
